'''Mona''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] female living on [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]] in the city of [[Noua]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Dado]], a local boy, lost his arm in an accident and Mona handled his injury and gave him a mixture that eased his pain, but was unable to provide him a proper medical aid.
